name: pilot
description: Curated 40-item factual QA pilot. Not TruthfulQA. mock_base_answer and mock_scenario are used only when LLM_MODE=mock and are never passed into live MetaQA prompts.
license: Original curated items for VeriFact research. Not copied from TruthfulQA.
source: Hand-selected factual questions spanning named entities, dates, numbers, locations, and general facts.

examples.question: Who wrote the play Hamlet?
